name: Watching the Roads

angles.text: As an Undead, you help secure Silverpine's roads and defend Forsaken borders from Dalaran's magical incursions.
As a member of the Horde, you help disrupt Dalaran's supply lines near Ambermill and hold the region against hostile human enclaves.
As a Priest, you see Shadow Priest Allister direct the offensive from the Sepulcher, where Forsaken clergy take an active part in border defense.
As a Mage, you face Dalaran's wizards and watchers, who use magical relics and patrols to guard passage. Their work makes them targets for rival spellcasters.

aliases: where to turn in watching the roads
faq.answer: Shadow Priest Allister gives the order from the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest. He sends champions against Kirin Tor patrols on the local roads.
faq.q: Who gives the quest Watching the Roads?

faq.answer: Shadow Priest Allister wants to stop magical relics and pendants from reaching Silverpine Forest from Dalaran. Striking the wizards and watchers near Ambermill cuts off their passage across Forsaken borders.
faq.q: Why are the Forsaken attacking Dalaran patrols near Ambermill?

faq.answer: The barrier around Dalaran has fallen. The Kirin Tor have tightened their watch on nearby roads and patrol the Ambermill region with suspicion.
faq.q: What is the situation with the barrier around Dalaran?

faq.answer: Dalaran Wizards and Dalaran Watchers patrol the roads around Ambermill in Silverpine Forest. They watch travel and guard Kirin Tor personnel and enchanted items.
faq.q: Where can the Dalaran Wizards and Watchers be found?

faq.answer: The Kirin Tor carry enchanted pendants and other magical relics from Dalaran into Silverpine Forest. Allister wants to stop them before the artifacts spread farther through the territory.
faq.q: What kind of items is Dalaran shipping along these roads?

faq.answer: The Kirin Tor watch the roads into Silverpine Forest closely since Dalaran's magical barrier fell. Allister sees their suspicion and vigilance, but the Forsaken at the Sepulcher do not know their exact motives.
faq.q: Why are the Kirin Tor so vigilant along the Ambermill roads?

sections.body: Near Ambermill, Kirin Tor wizards and sentries watch the roads into Silverpine Forest. Since the barrier around Dalaran fell, they have tightened their hold on travel across the border. From the Sepulcher, the Forsaken see the human magi using these roads to carry dangerous relics and enchanted pendants into contested lands.
sections.title: Tensions Along the Ambermill Road

sections.body: Shadow Priest Allister wants to stop the flow of Dalaran's magical goods at its source. He sends agents after the Kirin Tor escorts on the roads near Ambermill. By striking Dalaran Wizards and Dalaran Watchers, the Forsaken aim to break the Kirin Tor's hold on regional travel and guard their eastern frontier from outside arcane meddling.
sections.title: Severing the Supply Line

summary: Shadow Priest Allister sends the Forsaken against Kirin Tor patrols near Ambermill. With Dalaran's barrier down, their wizards and watchers guard the roads into Silverpine Forest while carrying magical goods into Forsaken lands.
